verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents bulk or batch operations across many items. The MCP server lets users update statuses, link deals and organize requests, but that describes per-item actions taken from an LLM, not a bulk capability. The existence of an API reference is a developer building block a user could script against, not a documented bulk feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
